verdict.rationale: Relay documents Visa debit and credit cards, and a community source notes a per-card ATM withdrawal limit. Nothing in the evidence addresses foreign transaction fees, ATM fees abroad, or currency-conversion markups, so the core claim of no hidden foreign fees is unevidenced. Card issuance alone is an adjacent feature, not support for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can spend and withdraw cash abroad on a company card without hidden foreign fees
